title: Dollar General Manager Gets Caught In Self Checkout Scheme
description:
On September 12th, 2022. A loss prevention manager came to the store to complete an audit and found out that one of the managers had been involved in aborting transactions from self checkout for one of her friends on a consistent basis and had been dating back 1 year. Subsequently, she was arrested a month later on a warrant.
